description: This source file provides a simulation backend for generating synthetic telemetry data for assets such as excavators and trucks. It includes functions for configuring simulation parameters via environment variables, generating readings with noise and spikes, managing simulation state and lifecycle (start/stop), and periodically inserting telemetry records and predictions into storage. The core logic revolves around an asyncio-based event loop that runs the simulation in the background.

classes.name: SimulatorState
classes.description: Data class that holds the state of the simulator, including the asyncio task, stop event, lock, and last error message.

methods.name: bool _env_truthy(name: str, default: bool = False)
methods.description: Reads an environment variable and interprets it as a boolean value based on typical truthy strings.

methods.name: tuple[float,float] _parse_interval_seconds(raw: str | None)
methods.description: Parses a string representing an interval (e.g., '2', '2-5') into a tuple of floats for min and max seconds, with defaults.

methods.name: float _clamp(v: float, lo: float, hi: float)
methods.description: Constrains a float value between specified lower and upper bounds.

methods.name: dict[str,float] _base_profile_for_type(asset_type: str)
methods.description: Provides baseline readings for asset types ('excavator' or 'truck').

methods.name: dict[str,float] _make_readings(prev: dict[str, float], asset_type: str, *, spike: bool)
methods.description: Generates simulated sensor readings with optional spikes, based on previous readings and asset type.

methods.name: AlertSeverity _severity_for_prediction(pred_severity: str, risk_score: float)
methods.description: Converts prediction severity string and risk score into an AlertSeverity enum.

methods.name: None _sim_loop( *, storage: StorageAdapter, stop_event: asyncio.Event, interval_min: float, interval_max: float, asset_ids: list[str] | None, )
methods.description: Asynchronous main loop that periodically generates and stores telemetry data, predictions, and alerts for a set of assets.

methods.name: tuple[bool,float,float] get_simulation_config()
methods.description: Reads environment variables to determine if simulation is enabled and the interval range.

methods.name: tuple[bool,float,float] start_simulator( *, storage: StorageAdapter, state: SimulatorState, asset_ids: list[str] | None = None, )
methods.description: Starts the simulation background task if enabled or manually triggered, managing concurrency with a lock.

methods.name: bool stop_simulator(*, state: SimulatorState)
methods.description: Stops the running simulation task gracefully and waits for its completion.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] get_simulator_status(state: SimulatorState)
methods.description: Provides a status dictionary indicating if the simulation is running, enabled, and interval range.
